Subject: Close orchestration: final commit checklist & forecast reconciliation

Team —

We have one week left in Q2 and ACME is signaling they’re ready to finalize. I want a short, focused 48-hour plan for finance and ops so we don’t miss the booking window. Goals: confirm PO timing, lock the final commit amount in forecast, and ensure SOW/PO are aligned to billing.

Please confirm the following by EOD today (28 Jun):
- David: update the commit_matrix with the final SKU/term and margin impact (I attached last week’s draft)
- Ben: call out any billing constraints (billing start dates, invoice terms, credit holds) and the expected recognition quarter
- I’ll coordinate with ACME on PO cadence and confirm signers — Jill is looped.

Quick cadence: we’ll do an internal 20-min check tomorrow 10:30 PT and then a final roll call on Wed 10:00 PT if PoC confirms. If any blocker, flag immediately.

Attachments: none in this message — referencing commit_matrix in Drive (link below).

Thanks,
Ava

Thanks. I updated the matrix (attached) with the ACME SKU breakdown and a conservative recognition schedule. Key notes:
- Committed ARR: $320,000 over 12 months (starts 7/1/2027) — line-item in commit_matrix.xlsx
- One-time onboarding fee in SOW: $15k (recognize per finance guidance, Q3 revenue)
- Billing cadence: monthly in arrears; invoice generation expected first week of Jul

I flagged margin impact under the "Notes" column — there is a 4% rate concession for the first 3 months per the negotiated pilot pricing. If Ben sees any issue with revenue recognition timing, let me know and I’ll re-run the forecast.

Attachment: commit_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
